acf.intro: Designing systems where cognitive errors are expensive. My methodology bridges ethnographic research with production-grade engineering to deliver resilient enterprise platforms.
acf.copy_1: Discovery & Cognitive Mapping: Uncovering critical user heuristics and understanding complex domain workflows before drawing a single screen.
acf.copy_2: Workflow Architecture & State Modeling: Mapping all 8 component states, edge cases, error boundaries, and permission levels.
acf.copy_3: Tokenized Design Systems: Building scalable Figma-to-code design tokens that align seamlessly with React, Vue, and Flutter engineers.
acf.copy_4: Production Handoff & QA Pairing: Pixel-perfect handoffs with flexbox alignment, motion curves, and continuous engineering pairing.
acf.copy_5: Metric-Driven Impact: Measuring real user task-completion rates, error recovery speed, and enterprise ARR growth.
